verdict.rationale: The documented alerting mechanism is Triggers, which fire on 'thresholds that you define and configure,' plus SLO burn alerts. Neither is anomaly detection that works without hand-written thresholds. The MCP docs say a connected external AI agent can 'identify performance outliers,' but that is prompted, agent-driven investigation rather than an automatic detection feature of the product, so it is adjacent at best. BubbleUp appears only as a pricing checkmark, with no description of what it does.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can enable anomaly or outlier detection that surfaces problems without hand-written thresholds
